name: hq
mood: Northstar HQ lobby: a calm, confident boutique-hotel lobby for a friendly tech company. Deep navy blue, polished brass, pale white oak, cream-and-grey marble checker floor, a single brass five-pointed star as the company emblem. Warm, architectural, a little grand.

items.prompt: A long lobby reception desk three floor tiles long: a front of navy-blue lacquered panels with slim brass trim and a large inlaid brass five-pointed star in the middle, a pale white-oak top, a small brass service bell, a vase of white tulips and a slim monitor on top. Its panelled front faces along the red arrow.
The SAME navy-and-brass reception desk seen from the receptionist's side: white-oak back with open shelves of folders, a drawer unit, the back of the monitor, the white tulips.
A sleek mid-century two-seat sofa in deep navy velvet with a low straight back, two seat cushions, thin brass-capped walnut legs.
The SAME navy velvet mid-century sofa seen from behind: its smooth navy back, brass-capped walnut legs.

A tall glass-fronted walnut trophy cabinet two tiles long with brass trim and three glass shelves holding small gold cups, a crystal award, framed certificates and a silver plate; soft light inside. Its glass front faces along the red arrow.
A company time capsule: a sealed brass-and-steel cylinder with rivets and a round porthole, standing upright on a small navy pedestal with an engraved brass plaque (no readable text).

sheets.name: trophy-back
sheets.note: The second reference is this exact trophy cabinet from the front. Draw the SAME cabinet from BEHIND: its plain walnut back panel with brass corner trim; the trophies are hidden.

items.prompt: The walnut trophy cabinet from the reference, seen from behind.
A small framed photo in a thin black frame, portrait 2:3: a cozy garage turned office at night — two laptops glowing on a folding table, a space heater, a whiteboard with a doodled rocket.
A small gilded frame, portrait 2:3, holding a framed first-dollar invoice: cream paper with a few handwritten signature squiggles and a single gold coin taped at the corner (no readable text).
A small white-oak frame, portrait 2:3, holding a group photo on a sunny Lisbon street: a yellow tram, terracotta roofs, a crowd of tiny happy people waving.
A small navy frame with a brass nameplate, portrait 2:3, holding a team photo of eight tiny smiling people in front of a brass star sign, confetti in the air.

A wide company emblem wall, about 2.3 : 1: vertical navy-blue wood slats with a large polished brass five-pointed star emblem in the centre, glowing softly with a warm halo, small brass pin lights along the top. No letters.

Art Deco elevator doors, about 1.15 : 1 (slightly wider than tall): two polished brass doors with engraved sunburst panels, a brass surround, a half-moon floor indicator dial with an arrow above, a small call button panel beside.
A cork bulletin board in a white-oak frame, about 1.5 : 1, covered with pinned polaroid photos of smiling people, colorful sticky notes and a paper welcome pennant (no readable text).

A tall walnut grandfather clock with brass trim: an arched top with a small brass star finial, a cream enamel clock face with brass hands, a glass door showing a long brass pendulum, carved feet. Its face and glass door face along the red arrow.
The SAME tall walnut grandfather clock seen from directly behind: its plain walnut back panel, the arched top with the brass star finial, carved feet.

A square museum display plinth about knee high: navy blue lacquered sides with a slim polished brass band at the foot and a brass-edged top, a flat cream marble top surface. Empty on top. Simple, elegant, symmetric.

A long upholstered lobby bench two tiles long with no back: a deep navy velvet cushion with button tufting in a row, a slim white-oak frame and four brass-capped tapered legs. Its long side runs along the red arrow.
The SAME backless navy velvet lobby bench seen from the other side: the tufted navy cushion, the white-oak frame, brass-capped legs.
A tall clipped boxwood topiary ball on a slim trunk, in a square polished brass planter box with a navy band.
A small round side table with a white marble top on three slim brass legs, a tiny vase of white tulips and a coffee-table book on it.
A polished brass museum stanchion post on a round weighted brass base, a short loop of deep red velvet rope hanging from the top ring.
